# Auth Module

Authentication and security services for ISAFlow — GoTrue-backed MFA, session management, and identity verification.

## Services

None remaining — custom TOTP service deleted in Task 12. MFA operations go through GoTrue directly via `src/lib/auth/gotrueMfa.ts`.

## API Endpoints

| Path | Methods | Auth |
|------|---------|------|
| `/api/auth/2fa-enroll` | POST | withAuth |
| `/api/auth/2fa-confirm` | POST | withAuth |
| `/api/auth/2fa-challenge` | POST | pending_token (no full auth) |
| `/api/auth/2fa-disable` | POST | withAuth |
| `/api/auth/2fa-status` | GET | withAuth |
| `/api/auth/reset-2fa` | POST | admin only |

## Key Rules

- Auth APIs use `withAuth` middleware (NOT `withCompany`)
- MFA factors stored in GoTrue `auth.mfa_factors` — NOT in `user_2fa` (table dropped in migration 354)
- Trusted devices table `user_trusted_devices` also dropped in migration 354
- Login flow: password → GoTrue signIn → if MFA enrolled, returns `requires_2fa + factor_id + pending_token` → `/api/auth/2fa-challenge` → issues session cookie
